exposure: poor sleep quality during the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: A total of 200 females aged 18-40 years with gestational age >=34 weeks and poor sleep quality were enrolled, excluding those with multiple fetuses or systemic diseases.
finding: The frequency of postpartum depression was high (28%) in females presenting with poor sleep quality during the third trimester of pregnancy, with poor sleep quality being a key correlate of PPD.
mod_finding: PPD prevalence did not differ by delivery mode.
